mapper.insert: insert into CHB_SALER_STL_DEAL_INFO ( REGIST_SEQNO, DATA_STATUS, INSTITUTION_CODE, PRD_REGIST_CODE, ACCOUNT_NO, ACCOUNT_NAME, TRADE_NO, TRADE_PS, TRADE_COUNTER_ACC_NO, TRADE_COUNTER_ACC_NAME, TRADE_COUNTER_ACC_BANK_NAME, TRADE_COUNTER_ACC_BANK_NO, TRADE_CCY, TRADE_AMT, TRADE_VDATE, TRADE_TIME, POSTSCRIPT, REMARK, RECEPT_DATE, ORG_CODE, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES ( #{registSeqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dataStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{institutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prdRegistCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradeNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradePs,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradeCounterAccNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradeCounterAccName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradeCounterAccBankName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradeCounterAccBankNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradeCcy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradeAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{tradeVdate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{tradeTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{postscript,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{receptDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
